title: Kung Fu Boy (功夫旋風兒) Vol. 20 – Chinese Edition – Tong Li Comics
categoryName: Collectibles:Comic Books & Memorabilia:Manga & Asian Comics:Single Volumes
descriptionText:
Condition: Very Good – minor shelf wear and light page yellowing consistent with age. Spine solid, no torn pages, no writing or stains (see photos).
Language: Traditional Chinese
Publisher: 東立出版社 (Tong Li Publishing Co., Ltd.)
Series: 正式授權中文版 少年系列 (Official Licensed Chinese Shōnen Edition)
ISBN: 957-34-0176-2
Price on cover: NT$60
Description
This is Volume 20 of the classic martial arts manga 功夫旋風兒 (Kung Fu Boy) by Tatsuya Egawa (蛭田達也), officially licensed and published in Taiwan by Tong Li Comics (東立出版社).
This volume continues the energetic adventures and comedy of the series’ hero in his martial arts journey. With its bold 90s art style and humor, it’s a great collectible for fans of vintage shōnen manga and Tong Li’s early licensed editions.
